refine_lm — 3D refine op

• Data kinds: voxel × voxel × position → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.refine_lm(scene, template, init_pos, device='cpu', iters=50, scale=True, gain=False, lam0=0.001, tol=1e-08) (to call the implementation directly, import match3d; match3d.refine_lm(scene, template, init_pos, device='cpu', iters=50, scale=True, gain=False, lam0=0.001, tol=1e-08); from the registry, ops3d.get("refine_lm"))

• GPU: this op has a GPU path (device="cuda")

Usage

Sub-voxel refinement of the translation (plus isotropic scale / intensity gain) by Levenberg-Marquardt.

Starting from the coarse match position init_pos (template centre in scene coordinates [z,y,x]), solves forward-additive Lucas-Kanade with damped Gauss-Newton (LM), minimising the SSD

E(p) = Σ_x [ I(W(x;p)) - g·T(x) ]²

over p. A downstream stage that converges coarse estimates from integer NCC / Fourier-Mellin / Hough to continuous coordinates.

Warp W(x;p) = t + s·(x - c_T) (c_T = template centre, t = translation, s = isotropic scale)

Jacobian ∂I(W)/∂p is obtained exactly by passing grid_sample through autodiff (analytic gradient of trilinear interpolation.

The fixed point coincides with the true SSD minimum → avoids the constant-factor bias of sobel, high accuracy).

LM Δp = -(H + λ·diag(H))⁻¹ b; on success (cost decrease) λ×0.4 damping, on failure λ×5 increase.

Arguments:

scene : scene volume (D,H,W).

template : template volume (Td,Th,Tw). Smaller than the scene.

init_pos : coarse template centre position [z,y,x] (voxel; e.g. [d,h,w] from NCC locate).

device : "cpu" / "cuda". Device-independent.

iters : maximum number of iterations (usually converges in 4-6).

scale : True optimises the isotropic scale s as well (4 parameters). False is translation only.

gain : True additionally optimises the luminance gain g (residual I(W)-g·T). Robust to brightness differences/noise.

lam0, tol : initial damping coefficient / convergence threshold (step norm, relative cost decrease).

Returns (dict):

pos : refined template centre [z,y,x] (continuous coordinates)

scale : isotropic scale (1.0 if scale=False)

gain : luminance gain (1.0 if gain=False)

cost : final SSD, rms: residual RMS per 1 voxel, iters: number of iterations run
